adjudication.rationale: Diff adds new admin controllers with access control and error paths but tests don’t exercise them. `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` and `Admin::EmbeddingController` both declare `before_filter :ensure_logged_in, :ensure_staff` (and `:fetch_embedding`), yet their specs only assert subclassing (`spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb`, `spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb`) and never make a request as a non-staff user to verify `ensure_staff` rejects access. Also, `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` renders `render_json_error(host)` when `host.save` fails (e.g., invalid `host` failing `EmbeddableHost` format validation), but there is no controller/request spec covering that failure response; the model spec covers trimming/allow checks but not the controller error rendering path.
